author: Sagan I
title: Fine-Tuning CNN-SE-LSTM with Lower LR (Exp. 6)
abstract: This experiment pivots back to the promising CNN-SE-LSTM architecture (score 39.5) after a series of failed PPO implementations. It tests the hypothesis that the performance of this model is bottlenecked by the default learning rate. The learning rate is slightly reduced from 4e-4 to 3e-4 to test for improved optimization stability and a potential new SOTA score.

original_submission.content:
"""
Submission by Sagan I.
Experiment 6: Fine-tuning the learning rate for the CNN-SE-LSTM.
Hypothesis: A slightly lower learning rate will unlock the full
potential of this architecture.
"""
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/sagan')
from ray import tune
from typing import Dict, Any

# Import my custom architecture from lineage storage
from architectures import CNN_SE_LSTM

def _define_hyperparameters() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([3e-4]), # <--- Key change: Lower LR
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'lstm_features': tune.choice([256]),
    }

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Create CNN-SE-LSTM network architecture."""
    return CNN_SE_LSTM(
        lstm_features=hparams['lstm_features'],
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2']
    )

# No training_step is defined, so the system default will be used.
